test_policy.notes: Catalog: 'Eastern University uses a test-optional admissions policy'; SAT/ACT are not required, though the university reserves the right to request scores. College Navigator adds that scores are generally not considered except for applicants with a GPA below 2.75.

requirements.notes: Eastern's online application is free. International applicants submit the online traditional undergraduate application; official transcripts evaluated and sent by a NACES member (e.g. WES, TEC, IFCS, ECE, IERF); an English test score unless waived; a passport scan; and a bank statement or letter plus the Statement of Financial Support. Optional: national exam results or the SAT, a one-page essay on fit with the university mission, and letters of reference. Decisions come within 4-6 weeks of a complete international file (1-2 weeks for domestic first-years). The I-20 requires admission, six months of sponsor financial statements covering tuition, room and board, and the international student health forms. The catalog expects a college-preparatory curriculum and a cumulative high school GPA of 2.0 or higher.

deadlines.label: Rolling admission (fall 2027 entry): no application closing date published
deadlines.notes: The first-year and international pages give no application deadline. The 2024-25 Common Data Set lists 8/1 as the application closing date for fall entry, but the admissions pages do not say so for fall 2027.

deadlines.label: International: all materials due 90 days before the intended start date
deadlines.notes: The international page says all materials must be received by Eastern no later than 90 days before the intended start date so the I-20 can be issued. For a late-August 2027 start that is roughly late May to early June 2027; the page does not print a calendar date.

english_policy.waiver_notes: The English test (TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo) is required if English is not an official language in the applicant's home country. It is waived with: an official statement from the previous school (or a link to its website) showing English was the language of instruction; two or more years of work in the U.S.; citizenship of a listed English-speaking country (the page lists, among others, Australia, Canada except Quebec, Ghana, Ireland, Jamaica, Kenya, Nigeria, Philippines, Singapore, South Africa and the United Kingdom); or a degree from a U.S. college or university. TOEFL must be taken within 2 years of the entry term. No conditional admission or ESL pathway is described for traditional undergraduates.

english.notes: English proficiency page: 'a minimum TOEFL score of 79 or 4 of the new 2026 scoring format'. TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo is accepted.
Application-steps page lists 'TOEFL: 4 (Internet-based test)'; the English page names it as the new 2026 scoring format.
Take the Academic version; IELTS sends scores directly and uses no institution code.
Minimum 115 on the international application-steps page for traditional undergraduates; the English page gives 100 only for online undergraduate and graduate programs.

aid.notes: International Student Grant of $15,000-$26,000 for qualified international students (cannot be combined with other Eastern aid); on-campus employment averages about $1,000 per year; Church Matching Grant and Ministerial Discount may apply. First-year merit awards of $16,000-$27,000 are described for all admitted first-years, but the pages do not say whether they apply to international students. The scholarships page says undocumented and international students who want need-based institutional aid must file a paper FAFSA with tax returns and a letter; whether such aid is awarded to internationals is not stated. International students are not eligible for federal aid. The 2024-25 CDS nonresident aid figures could not be read reliably, so none are recorded.

cost.notes: From the 2026-27 Tuition & Fees page (effective fall 2026 and spring 2027). Tuition $20,280 per semester x2 = $40,560 (12-18 credits). Student services fee $373 per semester x2 = $746. Room and board uses basic housing ($3,866 per semester) plus the board plan ($3,497 per semester) x2 = $14,726; other room types run up to $4,883 per semester (apartment) and a single-room premium of $775 per semester applies

sat.note: No SAT code is printed on the admissions pages.

act.note: No ACT code is printed on the admissions pages.

ielts.note: IELTS uses no institution code; scores are sent directly from IELTS.
